title: Cyber criminals reportedly siphon money from Panchayati Raj Institution bank accounts in Hisar, Haryana
date_note: Date of the Tribune report, which gives the withdrawals as spread over five days from November 11 to 15 and no earlier disclosure day.
geo_basis: victim city stated in the article
summary: The Tribune reports that cyber criminals siphoned off around Rs 7 crore from Panchayati Raj Institution accounts in Hisar and other districts of Haryana. It says a preliminary inquiry found about Rs 5.5 crore taken in Hisar district, in withdrawals spread over five days in November, and that sources said the hackers could not be traced so far. The article does not name the banks.
plain: The Tribune reports that hackers took around Rs 7 crore from local-government bank accounts in Haryana; a preliminary inquiry found about Rs 5.5 crore in Hisar district. The hackers have not been traced, sources said.
exec: The Tribune reports about Rs 5.5 crore was taken from local-government accounts in Hisar, per a preliminary inquiry; the cause is not detailed.
